family.description: This family includes animal riboflavin transporters belonging to the Solute carrier family 52 (SLC52). They are plasma membrane proteins that transport vitamin B2 (riboflavin, RF) into cells [[cite:PUB00078059]]. In case of infection by retroviruses, they act as cell receptors to retroviral envelopes similar to the porcine endogenous retrovirus (PERV-A) [[cite:PUB00078058]]. These proteins belong to the MFS superfamily [[cite:PUB00103553]].
family.name: Solute carrier family 52, riboflavin transporter
